fix: Do not set up an unused wallet from the reseller, and never type an existing recovery phrase into one. Keep the wallet and contact Trezor Support, which offers a new Trezor wallet to anyone who bought from the reseller since March. Version 2.13.1 was released for the Safe 7, Safe 5, Safe 3 and Model T, according to the company's firmware changelog.
impact: The implant reads the phrase from the wallet's screen and sends it over the mobile network to a server controlled by the attackers. The company examined one of the wallets in its lab, identified the other two from photos their owners sent, and has had no reports of lost funds. The implant copies the recovery phrase when the wallet shows it during backup creation, and when someone types it in to restore an existing wallet to the device.
